_readme: DANK BKK food & drinks menu. EDIT THIS FILE to change what customers see on food.html. Price is in baht. 'cat' must be one of the ids in 'categories'. Set "out": true to grey an item out as sold out. Staff can also edit live from the POS.

_bundlesReadme: Bundle promotions. 'parts' lists the menu item ids that come in the set, so the normal price and the saving are worked out from the live item prices — change an item price and the deal stays honest by itself. 'hours' is optional: from/to in 24h shop time, days 0=Sun..6=Sat. Delete a bundle to pull the promo.

_imgReadme: Every item has an 'img'. These are free-licence Unsplash photos (free for commercial use, no attribution required) chosen to match the dish. To use your own photo, drop the file in /assets and change img to e.g. "assets/padthai.jpg". If an image ever fails to load the card falls back to the emoji tile on its own, so a broken link never leaves a blank card. 'ing' and 'alg' are the ingredients and allergens shown on the back when a customer taps the card.
